fact: The Partnership Compact of October 2023 between the Ministry of Education and GPE sets as a system priority the consolidation and extension of SIGE to all subsystems, with new variables for special needs and the integration of private schools, and carries an indicator, per cent of schools with a functional SIGE reporting complete and good-quality data, with no baseline available (n.d.) and a target of 100%.
title: Pacto de Parceria: Melhorar a inclusão e qualidade das aprendizagens da Educação Pré-escolar e do 1º Ciclo do EBO
publisher: Ministério da Educação de Cabo Verde / Global Partnership for Education
